description: Opening-line templates for a LinkedIn post, filled with the user's topic, audience and result. Anything the user has not supplied stays in [brackets] to replace with a real detail; nothing is invented.

audience.description: Who the post is for, e.g. founders.

result.description: A real result the user can back up, e.g. hired 4 engineers in 30 days.

topic.description: What the post is about, e.g. hiring engineers.

name: generate_linkedin_hooks
title: LinkedIn hook ideas
